summary: Iteration 7: scheduling (free slots, schedule settings), portal 409 overlap, confirm uses duration from settings, 24h visit-reminders cron, reminder reset on PATCH date/time. 20/20 backend pytest pass. Frontend: parent /portale booking dialog shows 14 free slots 09:00-12:15 for Prima visita on Studio Centro Monday (matches API arithmetic), hours info 'Aperto lun, mar, mer, gio, ven 09:00-13:00 · durata 45 min' rendered, submit disabled until a slot is picked and enabled after, Saturday -> portal-request-no-slots message. Doctor dashboard /app shows schedule-open-btn in portal-requests section; schedule-dialog opens with Studio Centro (09:00-13:00, Mon-Fri) and Studio Provincia (15:00-19:00, Mon-Fri), 4 duration inputs with defaults 45/30/20/20, day toggle (Sat false->true) works, schedule-save-btn persists and closes dialog. 390px: zero horizontal overflow on both dialogs. Backend coverage: GET/PUT /api/settings/schedule validations (missing clinic 400, end<=start 400, duration out of range 422, missing duration key 422); GET /api/portal/slots (Prima visita 45 -> 14 slots 09:00..12:15, Bilancio 30 -> 15 slots 15:00..18:30, weekend [], past date [], non-linked child 404, invalid clinic 400); POST /api/portal/appointment-requests time outside slots -> 409; booking a free slot then slot disappears for same service/clinic/date; doctor confirm applies duration from settings (custom 25 min verified on appointment.duration via /appointments/upcoming); cron /api/cron/visit-reminders without/with wrong Bearer -> 401, with correct Bearer -> 202 {accepted:true}, same X-Webhook-Id -> {accepted:true,duplicate:true}; PATCH /appointments/{aid} date and time return 200 (reminder reset in server.py line 530 is covered by code review).
critical_code_review_comments: scheduling.py free_slots applies `earliest = now.hour*60+now.minute+60 if d==today`: this silently drops any same-day slots less than 60 minutes away. Business rule not stated in requirements; worth confirming (requirements say 'past date -> []' only).

scheduling.py send_reminders claim-and-send pattern sets reminder_sent_at BEFORE calling send_email, then resets to None on exception. If the process crashes between $set and send_email the reminder is lost for good. Consider a more durable queue, or at least a status like 'sending' + retry on next tick.
scheduling.py BRING dict + BRING_DEFAULT: unchanged test — reminder content matches review spec (per-service bring text, child name, date/time, studio/address).

scheduling.py put_schedule: Pydantic ScheduleIn validates durations keys exactly (set equality) and 5..240 range; however `hours` dict has no model-level clinic enum — matching clinic names relies on put_schedule's set-equality check vs schedule_of(u) names. Good, but a changed clinics list on the user doc could cause unexpected 400s after rename; document for admin/clinic rename flows.

portal_flow.py confirm uses `schedule_of(owner)["durations"].get(r['service'], 30)` — correct; but note: if the parent later changes service via a new request the duration stored on the confirmed appointment is fixed at confirm time (good). If the doctor changes schedule durations AFTER confirming, the existing appointment keeps its old duration (also good).
scheduling.py cron endpoint stores run idempotency in db.cron_runs with `_id=run_id` and never prunes — long-term unbounded growth. Add TTL index on `at` or periodic cleanup.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke on both parent dialog and doctor schedule dialog
